project_description: We operate 14 diagnostic centers and receive over 600 inbound patient calls daily for test pricing, home sample collection booking, and report status checks. Our front desk misses 30% of calls during peak morning hours. We want an AI voice agent that handles Hindi and English phone inquiries, books home collection slots directly into our CRM, and escalates urgent clinical queries to human staff.

We manage 1,200 residential rental units across Pune and Bengaluru and want a custom tenant operations portal with automated rent invoicing, lease renewal alerts, maintenance ticket routing, and a landlord analytics dashboard. We saw TenantEase on Cynbit's site and want to understand whether we can license or customize a similar full-stack architecture integrated with Razorpay.

Our operations team manually reads 300+ vendor invoices and GST PDFs every week and enters line items into our accounting ERP. We need an LLM-powered document extraction and validation agent with a human-in-the-loop review queue so anomalies are flagged before ERP sync.

We have 9 dermatology clinics and struggle to monitor Google and Practo reviews consistently. We want an automated review intelligence dashboard similar to Revio that detects negative sentiment spikes, categorizes complaints by clinic branch, and drafts empathetic manager-approved responses.

Our sales reps receive leads from website forms, LinkedIn ads, and trade expos, but everything sits in spreadsheets. We need end-to-end CRM automation with lead scoring, automated WhatsApp and email follow-up sequences, HubSpot synchronization, and weekly pipeline conversion reporting.

Our monolithic e-commerce backend currently runs on single-instance VMs and suffers outages during flash sales. We need AWS cloud infrastructure modernization with Docker containers, autoscaling, RDS PostgreSQL migration, zero-downtime CI/CD pipelines, and Prometheus monitoring.

We recently launched our D2C handloom apparel store and organic traffic is flat. Looking for technical SEO fixes, structured product schema, Core Web Vitals speed improvements, and a Google Shopping campaign setup.
We are exploring a partnership for student coding bootcamps and remote internship mentorship tracking. Could you share how BitElevate or Cynbit Studio structures cohort assessments?
